description: Implementation of Windows-specific URL security management using WinINet/IE's security zone manager, including credential policy handling and security manager initialization.

classes.name: URLSecurityManagerWin
classes.description: Windows-specific implementation of URLSecurityManager allowing credential policies based on Internet Explorer security zones.

methods.name: CanUseDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Determines if default credentials can be used for a given URL, based on security zone policies.

methods.name: EnsureSystemSecurityManager
methods.description: Initializes the security manager COM object if not already initialized.
